item.title: <i>Orchestra for Oliver</i> is the beautiful story of a life briefly lived
item.description: Parents facing a fetal diagnosis that will cause their baby’s death soon after birth often feel lost, alone, scared, and even angry. This tragic scenario is difficult enough for parents to wrap their heads around, [...]

item.title: Before becoming bishop, Pope Leo kept an all-night vigil with this saint
item.description: On the eve of his ordination in Chiclayo, the future pope traveled to a small town in northern Peru to pray before a relic of St. Turibius of Mogrovejo, a missionary bishop.

item.title: Bishops urge action on bill to examine Indian boarding school policies
item.description: “The pain from the Native American boarding school era continues to echo today,” four U.S. bishops wrote to lawmakers.

item.title: Belgian bishop plans to ordain married men by 2028, violating Church canon law
item.description: Bishop Johan Bonny expressed his plan to ordain married men into the priesthood by 2028 in a move that has not received approval from the Vatican and would violate the current Code of Canon Law.

item.title: Molotov cocktail thrown at participants at March for Life in Lisbon, Portugal
item.description: After the incendiary device failed to ignite, a suspect was arrested. The march organizers called it an act of terrorism, and the patriarch of Lisbon condemned the attack.

item.title: Kermit Gosnell, ‘America’s biggest serial killer,’ dies in prison
item.description: Abortionist and convicted serial killer Kermit Gosnell, believed to have murdered thousands and convicted of involuntary manslaughter of a woman and the murders of three infants, died in prison at 85.

item.title: From the altar to the track: Marathon-running cardinal highlights spirituality of sport
item.description: Cardinal Jean-Paul Vesco, the archbishop of Algiers, Algeria, said running is for him a “school of prayer.”

item.title: Archbishop of Bamenda reflects on planned papal visit to Cameroon
item.description: Archbishop Andrew Fuanya Nkea has described the upcoming apostolic visit of Pope Leo XIV to Cameroon as an unexpected moment of grace for the nation.
